relocation_exemption.description: Qualifying removal expenses and benefits are exempt up to the cap. The excess is taxable.

housing_rent.label: Housing in London
housing_rent.reason: Rent paid by the employer for the employee's home is taxable. Valued at the rent paid.
housing_rent.assumption: The employer holds the tenancy and the rent exceeds the property's annual value. If the employee is the tenant, the same amount is taxed as earnings instead.

relocation_allowance.label: Relocation allowance
relocation_allowance.reason: A fixed cash allowance is not a reimbursement of actual qualifying expenses, so it is not exempt.
relocation_allowance.assumption: Paid as a fixed allowance without receipts.

moving_costs.label: Moving costs (flights, shipping)
moving_costs.reason: Travel and transport of belongings for a job-related move count towards the shared exemption cap.

temporary_housing.label: Temporary housing (serviced apartment)
temporary_housing.reason: Temporary living accommodation before moving into the permanent home counts towards the shared exemption cap, valued at the employer's cost.
temporary_housing.assumption: The employee intends to move into the rented London flat as permanent accommodation.
